metadata.short_desc: Debounce, conversation graph, vibe probe, and humanized pacing.
metadata.desc: Replace the naive message-to-LLM pipeline with a group-chat state machine.

console.title: Chat Dynamics Console
console.desc: Monitor vibe, cooling, and conversation graphs by UMO session. Cool or reset session state.

config.title: Plugin Config
config.desc: Choose your groups and keep the defaults. Open advanced settings when you need more control.

memory.title: Notebook
memory.desc: Anniversaries, reminders, and slang trials; forget or mute tonight.

replay.title: Scene Replay
replay.desc: Color-block timeline of why the bot spoke or stayed quiet; no plaintext by default.

learning.title: Decision model
learning.desc: Native Jev status and read-only history export.

app.title: Chat Dynamics
app.desc: Settings, console, decision models, memory and replay in one workspace.
